text:
violet-partners: Kickoff: Helix Solutions marketplace onboarding (AWS/GCP/Azure). Need owners for IAM/KMS examples, legal addendum (KMS rotation + audit access), SKU manifest, staging assets, and joint launch comms. Who takes what?

omar-cloud: I can do IAM + KMS snippets for all three clouds. Will include cross-account publish examples and a Terraform manifest. Target: Tue EOD.

jess-legal: I'll draft the marketplace addendum. Helix asked for explicit customer-managed key language and a 90-day rotation clause. Need final SKU IDs to reference.

rene-product: I'll own SKU naming and trial packaging. Proposing ids: ["helix-core", "helix-dedicated", "helix-private-trial"]. Will upload CSV in thread.

maya-ops: Trials need metadata (duration, seats, auto-terminate). Also confirm support level text and telemetry permission.

sam-eng: I'll produce staging screenshots and a 60s demo. Requesting a staging publisher account from @violet-partners.

ovar-cloud: Quick AWS AssumeRole example to include in the templates:
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Action": ["sts:AssumeRole"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/HelixPublisher"
    }
  ]
}
```

omar-cloud: GCP impersonation (gcloud):
```bash
gcloud iam service-accounts add-iam-policy-binding helix-sa@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com \\
  --member='serviceAccount:publisher@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com' \\
  --role='roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator'
```

omar-cloud: Azure role assignment (az cli):
```bash
az role assignment create --assignee-object-id <PUBLISHER_ID> --role "Contributor" --scope /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>
```

jess-legal: If SKU IDs land by Mon we'll aim to finish the addendum by Thu. I'll include KMS rotation text and an audit-log access window of 30 days.

rene-product: CSV uploaded: ["helix-core","helix-dedicated","helix-private-trial"], billing units noted in the doc.

maya-ops: Partner approved anonymized telemetry sharing. Support email for listing: partners-support@redwood.com. Adding trial metadata to manifest.

sam-eng: Received staging creds from @violet-partners via secure channel. Will upload screenshots to the manifest doc when ready.

doc-bot: New doc created: /docs/marketplace/helix-manifest-v1.md

violet-partners: Thanks everyone. Next sync Thu 9:30am PT to check legal + IAM PRs and sign off on staging pass. Action items: @omar-cloud -> IAM + TF by Tue; @rene-product -> finalize SKU CSV; @jess-legal -> amendment draft; @sam-eng -> staging assets. :thumbsup:
